note: Buds and leaves before bud break (Upreti 2013, Burondkar 2016, Shivashankara 2019). Ethylene rise reported in India and Philippines, not in Florida.
Cytokinin peaks 5 to 10 days after full bloom (Chen 1983); ABA-like inhibitor high in first 21 days with heavy drop (Ram 1992); GA mostly in seed. Ethylene linked to drop peak at 6 to 9 DAA.
Climacteric. Pulp ABA rises day 2 and peaks day 4 with ethylene (Zaharah 2012); IAA highest before climacteric then falls; ethylene peak 9.6 to 13.3 µL/kg/h (Chomba 2025).
Cool-temperature induction. Bud cytokinins rise, GA and IAA fall (Hegele 2010; Chen 1991). ABA rise from review.
Fruitlet ethylene rises about 15-fold before drop (Li 2015). Seedless litchi: IAA and ABA up at drop (snippet only).
Non-climacteric. Peel and aril ABA rise about 62 days after full bloom, a week before colouring, then a small ethylene peak (Wang 2001). IAA fall inferred.
KClO3 induction. GA falls in ELISA studies but rises in LC-MS study (Susawaengsup 2011); ethylene up in leaves (Huang 2021 review).
GA4+7 peaks at 14, 44 and 92 days after full bloom; IAA low before day 29 and high after day 44; zeatin ribosides high early (Chuliang).
Non-climacteric fruit; pattern taken from litchi and other non-climacteric fruits. No longan ripening hormone data found.
Paclobutrazol lowers GA and raises kinetin; adding ethephon lowers ABA and gives most flowers (Sakhidin and Suparto). Direction only.
General fruit-set pattern: auxin, GA and cytokinin from seeds rise; ABA and ethylene rise in fruit that drops. No durian data found.
Climacteric. Ethylene below 0.02 then peak 8.5 to 10.4 µL/kg/h on day 8 (Tongdee 1989). ABA and IAA directions inferred.
General tree pattern; drought-triggered flowering. No mangosteen hormone data found.
Fruit develops without pollination (apomictic seed). No mangosteen data found.
Ethylene peak reported (day 11, units unclear). ABA and IAA directions inferred.
General tree pattern; paclobutrazol used to induce flowering. No rambutan hormone data found.
General fruit-set pattern. No rambutan data found.
Non-climacteric. Ethylene stays at 0.1 to 0.7 µL/kg/h (UC Davis). ABA and IAA directions inferred.
Flowers after a set number of leaves, not by a seasonal trigger. No flowering hormone data found.
Parthenocarpic: fruit grows without seeds, so auxin and GA come from the ovary. No measured series found.
Climacteric. ABA rises day 2 and peaks day 4; ethylene peaks about day 5 (snippets). IAA fall inferred.
Flowers continuously on the main stem; no induction stage. No data found.
General fruit-set pattern. No papaya data found.
Climacteric in most studies; Golden peak about 2.1 µL/kg/h on day 7 (Bron and Jacomino 2006). ABA and IAA inferred.
Ethephon forcing: ethylene, ABA and 2-iP rise; IAA, GA3 and zeatin fall; ethylene peaks about day 8 (Liu 2011; Li 2016).
Parthenocarpic fruit. No data found.
Non-climacteric. ABA switches on an ethylene gene (Shu 2026); values in supplement. IAA inferred.
Flowers on new shoots after pruning. No hormone data found.
General fruit-set pattern. No guava data found.
Depends on cultivar: some climacteric, some not (Taiwan data; units unclear). ABA and IAA inferred.
No flowering hormone data found.
General fruit-set pattern. ACC measured in a drop study, values not retrieved.
Climacteric; ethylene starts at colour change 70 to 80 days after flowering. Peak values conflict (7.25 vs 160 to 400 µL/kg/h).
GA sprays and GA blockers change flowering, so GA likely falls; no bud hormone measurements found.
Seed is the main source of IAA and cytokinin early; ABA falls as fruit grows (Cowan, Bertling; ratios only).
Climacteric after harvest only: ethylene peaks about day 8 to 9, respiration day 9 to 10 at 20 °C. ABA and IAA inferred.
Lemon under drought: bud ABA rises briefly, IAA rises, GA3 not detectable (Li 2017). GA sprays block flowering.
Ovary GA1 rises at flowering (Ben-Cheikh 1997); ABA and ACC rise up to 20-fold before fruitlet drop (Gómez-Cadenas 2000).
Non-climacteric. Peel ABA rises with colour change and with ethylene (Brisker 1976); whether ABA drives colour change is disputed.
